name: Article 26, after § 1 – 362
title: REPORT on the proposal for a regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council on the Union Civil Protection Mechanism and Union support for health emergency preparedness and response, and repealing Decision No 1313/2013/EU (Union Civil Protection Mechanism)
part_text: 1a. The main purpose of the Hub is to provide support in the event of a crisis for coordination at European level between other response mechanisms established under other Union legislation and set up by the Commission Directorates-General for each sector affected by the crisis.
